sampling.method: stratified deterministic sample from the locked 100-app manifest
additional_risk_strata: MCP true, false, and unknown with lifecycle stages
technical buildability yes, limited, no, and unknown

ground_truth.method: human review of the locked sample using current first-party evidence, with field-level decisions and unresolved values retained when evidence cannot establish a label
ground_truth.blindness: reviewers lock labels from the evidence packet before seeing researcher/verifier labels
ground_truth.disagreement: record a field-level adjudication, correction reason, and supporting URL; never silently overwrite the run

scoring.correct: value and material qualification match the locked human ground truth
scoring.partial: core direction is right but a material qualifier, access tier, MCP stage, or friction distinction is incomplete
scoring.wrong: value contradicts the locked human ground truth
scoring.unverifiable: ground truth cannot be established from accessible current evidence
scoring.corrections: report first-pass and final metrics with denominators; exclude unverifiable fields from correctness rates and show their count separately
